newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch ING to take over Equitable of Iowa.
newsitem.headline: Dutch ING to take over Equitable of Iowa.

text.p: Dutch banking and insurance group ING Groep NV said on Tuesday it had reached agreement to acquire Equitable of Iowa Companies.
ING said it planned to pay $68 per share in its own shares and/or cash for Equitable of Iowa in a deal worth $2.2 billion.

The acquisition would make a small positive contribution to ING's earnings per share in the first year and roughly double ING's U.S. life insurance premium income to $4.3 billion from $2.2 billion, the Dutch group said in a statement.
ING said the acquisition was the biggest it had made since its formation in 1991 as a result of a merger between bank NMB Postbank and insurer Nationale Nederlanden.
It said up to 60 percent of the purchase sum could be paid in ING shares which it already held and the rest through borrowed funds.
The acquisition had the backing of the Equitable of Iowa board and was expected to be completed in the fourth quarter of 1997, it added.
